title: Constraint damping on subextremal Kerr spacetimes
summary: In the context of hyperbolic formulations of Einstein's field equations obtained via gauge fixing, constraint damping is a desirable feature that ensures that violations of the gauge condition and thus of the constraint equations are suppressed in evolution. Besides its utility in numerical relativity, it has played a key role in several (linear and nonlinear) stability proofs of spacetimes as solutions of the Einstein equation.
